result.summary: The page is mostly intact; the only clear visual defect is a stray horizontal bar overlapping the bottom navigation icons. Clipped carousel items at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom are intentional scroll behavior and not defects.

issues.description: A thick gray horizontal bar runs through the bottom navigation, overlapping the search and orders icons, making the tab bar look broken and the active state ambiguous (the home icon is highlighted green separately).
issues.suggestion: Remove the stray bar or reposition it so it does not intersect the navigation icons, and keep the active-tab indicator aligned with a single tab.
